ÇYD · 7th Grade · Theme 1

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece sees an official notice about a new school event. It gives important news to everyone in the school. It is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) announcement

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece sees an official notice about a new school event. It gives important news to everyone in the school.” Bu tarif “announcement” kelimesine uyar; announcement = duyuru. Diğer şıklar: workshop (atölye), sack race (çuval yarışı), school club (okul kulübü).

2

Selin prepares a long piece of school work about plant growth. She researches, records results and presents her findings at the end. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) science project

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin prepares a long piece of school work about plant growth. She researches, records results and presents her findings at the end.” Bu tarif “science project” kelimesine uyar; science project = bilim projesi. Diğer şıklar: playing field (oyun, spor sahası), celebration at school (okulda kutlama), graduation (mezuniyet).

3

Duru attends a session where students shape clay into bowls. A teacher shows them how to make and decorate the objects. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) ceramic workshop

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru attends a session where students shape clay into bowls. A teacher shows them how to make and decorate the objects.” Bu tarif “ceramic workshop” kelimesine uyar; ceramic workshop = seramik atölyesi. Diğer şıklar: experiment (deney), sack race (çuval yarışı), announcement (duyuru).

4

Elif stands beside all her classmates in front of a camera. One picture includes everyone together. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) group photo

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif stands beside all her classmates in front of a camera. One picture includes everyone together.” Bu tarif “group photo” kelimesine uyar; group photo = grup fotoğrafı. Diğer şıklar: celebration at school (okulda kutlama), workshop (atölye), science project (bilim projesi).

5

Nehir's team holds one end of a thick rope. Another team pulls the opposite end, and both sides try to pull the other over a line. They play ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) tug-of-war

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir's team holds one end of a thick rope. Another team pulls the opposite end, and both sides try to pull the other over a line.” Bu tarif “tug-of-war” kelimesine uyar; tug-of-war = halat çekme. Diğer şıklar: playing field (oyun, spor sahası), school club (okul kulübü), ceramic workshop (seramik atölyesi).

6

Sena completes a stage of her education. She attends a ceremony marking the end of her studies at that school. She celebrates her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) graduation

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena completes a stage of her education. She attends a ceremony marking the end of her studies at that school.” Bu tarif “graduation” kelimesine uyar; graduation = mezuniyet. Diğer şıklar: group photo (grup fotoğrafı), experiment (deney), science project (bilim projesi).

7

İpek joins a school contest and takes part in its activities. She does not just watch from the audience. She is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) participant

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek joins a school contest and takes part in its activities. She does not just watch from the audience.” Bu tarif “participant” kelimesine uyar; participant = katılımcı. Diğer şıklar: award (ödül), prize-giving ceremony (ödül töreni), prize (ödül).

8

Eylül finishes first in a contest. She gets the top position rather than second or third place. She is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) winner

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül finishes first in a contest. She gets the top position rather than second or third place.” Bu tarif “winner” kelimesine uyar; winner = kazanan. Diğer şıklar: competition (yarışma), applicant (başvuru sahibi, aday), achievement (başarı).

9

Cemre spends time and energy preparing for a contest. She tries hard even when the work is difficult. She makes a great ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) effort

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre spends time and energy preparing for a contest. She tries hard even when the work is difficult.” Bu tarif “effort” kelimesine uyar; effort = çaba. Diğer şıklar: approval (onay), result (sonuç), prize-giving ceremony (ödül töreni).

10

Melis enjoys walking in hilly countryside. Her routes lead up and down hills rather than along city streets. Her activity is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) hillwalking

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis enjoys walking in hilly countryside. Her routes lead up and down hills rather than along city streets.” Bu tarif “hillwalking” kelimesine uyar; hillwalking = tepelerde doğa yürüyüşü. Diğer şıklar: adventurous activity (macera dolu etkinlik), nature club (doğa kulübü), guide (rehber).

11

Sıla sits in a small boat. She pulls oars through the water to move the boat forward. Her activity is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) rowing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla sits in a small boat. She pulls oars through the water to move the boat forward.” Bu tarif “rowing” kelimesine uyar; rowing = kürek çekme. Diğer şıklar: school trip (okul gezisi), view (manzara), forest (orman).

12

Defne visits a large area of water surrounded by land. It is not part of the sea and does not flow like a river. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) lake

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne visits a large area of water surrounded by land. It is not part of the sea and does not flow like a river.” Bu tarif “lake” kelimesine uyar; lake = göl. Diğer şıklar: mountain (dağ), fresh air (temiz hava), mountain biking (dağ bisikleti).

13

Buse checks a map before a trip. She chooses the path she plans to follow from one place to another. This path is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) route

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse checks a map before a trip. She chooses the path she plans to follow from one place to another.” Bu tarif “route” kelimesine uyar; route = rota, güzergâh. Diğer şıklar: school trip (okul gezisi), adventurous activity (macera dolu etkinlik), view (manzara).

14

İdil wants help booking transport and a holiday. She visits a business that arranges trips for customers. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) travel agency

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil wants help booking transport and a holiday. She visits a business that arranges trips for customers.” Bu tarif “travel agency” kelimesine uyar; travel agency = seyahat acentesi. Diğer şıklar: room service (oda servisi), itinerary (gezi programı), hotel (otel).

15

Zeynep travels from Adana to Ankara. Ankara is the place she wants to reach at the end of her journey. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) destination

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep travels from Adana to Ankara. Ankara is the place she wants to reach at the end of her journey.” Bu tarif “destination” kelimesine uyar; destination = varış yeri. Diğer şıklar: cruise (gemi gezisi), historic site (tarihî yer), resort (tatil köyü).

16

Mina plans to enter a country that requires official permission for her visit. She applies for that permission before travelling. She needs a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) visa

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina plans to enter a country that requires official permission for her visit. She applies for that permission before travelling.” Bu tarif “visa” kelimesine uyar; visa = vize. Diğer şıklar: e-ticket (e-bilet), city tour (şehir turu), accommodation (konaklama).

17

Pelin stays at a hotel and orders a meal from her room. A hotel worker brings the food directly to her door. She uses ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) room service

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin stays at a hotel and orders a meal from her room. A hotel worker brings the food directly to her door.” Bu tarif “room service” kelimesine uyar; room service = oda servisi. Diğer şıklar: resort (tatil köyü), travel agency (seyahat acentesi), destination (varış yeri).

18

Derya visits the remains of an ancient city. The place is important because of its connection with history. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) historic site

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya visits the remains of an ancient city. The place is important because of its connection with history.” Bu tarif “historic site” kelimesine uyar; historic site = tarihî yer. Diğer şıklar: cruise (gemi gezisi), hotel (otel), accommodation (konaklama).

19

Sena learns about traditions, historic buildings and crafts passed down through generations. These things connect a community with its past. They form its ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) cultural heritage

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena learns about traditions, historic buildings and crafts passed down through generations. These things connect a community with its past.” Bu tarif “cultural heritage” kelimesine uyar; cultural heritage = kültürel miras. Diğer şıklar: tea ceremony (çay seremonisi), solidarity (dayanışma), calligraphy (hat, güzel yazı sanatı).

20

Eda stands respectfully before a national event. A special song representing her country plays. She listens to the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) national anthem

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda stands respectfully before a national event. A special song representing her country plays.” Bu tarif “national anthem” kelimesine uyar; national anthem = millî marş. Diğer şıklar: welcome (karşılamak), give a speech (konuşma yapmak), collaborate (iş birliği yapmak).

21

Cem studies the protections and freedoms that belong to every child. These include education, safety and the chance to be heard. He learns about ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) children's rights

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem studies the protections and freedoms that belong to every child. These include education, safety and the chance to be heard.” Bu tarif “children's rights” kelimesine uyar; children's rights = çocuk hakları. Diğer şıklar: compassion (merhamet), hospitality (misafirperverlik), cultural heritage (kültürel miras).

22

Eren learns about a country that governs itself. Another country does not control its decisions. The country has ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) independence

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren learns about a country that governs itself. Another country does not control its decisions.” Bu tarif “independence” kelimesine uyar; independence = bağımsızlık. Diğer şıklar: calligraphy (hat, güzel yazı sanatı), national anthem (millî marş), solidarity (dayanışma).

23

Baran and his classmates combine their ideas for one shared project. They cooperate rather than working separately on competing plans. They ______ to reach their goal.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) collaborate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran and his classmates combine their ideas for one shared project. They cooperate rather than working separately on competing plans.” Bu tarif “collaborate” kelimesine uyar; collaborate = iş birliği yapmak. Diğer şıklar: hold an event (etkinlik düzenlemek), organise (düzenlemek), require (gerektirmek).

24

Tolga meets new students at the school gate. He greets them warmly and makes them feel wanted. He tries to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) welcome

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga meets new students at the school gate. He greets them warmly and makes them feel wanted.” Bu tarif “welcome” kelimesine uyar; welcome = karşılamak. Diğer şıklar: announce (duyurmak), check (kontrol etmek), perform (sahne almak, gösteri yapmak).

25

Ozan's group has several ideas for an event. The students talk about the ideas and exchange opinions. They ______ the options.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) discuss

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan's group has several ideas for an event. The students talk about the ideas and exchange opinions.” Bu tarif “discuss” kelimesine uyar; discuss = tartışmak, görüşmek. Diğer şıklar: practise (pratik yapmak), take part in (katılmak), prepare (hazırlamak).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert attends a practical session led by an expert. Students learn a skill by doing tasks themselves. The session is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) workshop

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert attends a practical session led by an expert. Students learn a skill by doing tasks themselves.” Bu tarif “workshop” kelimesine uyar; workshop = atölye. Diğer şıklar: celebration at school (okulda kutlama), sack race (çuval yarışı), graduation (mezuniyet).

2

Bora wants to test whether light affects a plant. He changes one condition and compares what happens. He does an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) experiment

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora wants to test whether light affects a plant. He changes one condition and compares what happens.” Bu tarif “experiment” kelimesine uyar; experiment = deney. Diğer şıklar: tug-of-war (halat çekme), playing field (oyun, spor sahası), ceramic workshop (seramik atölyesi).

3

Arda belongs to an organised group of students with a shared interest. They meet regularly after lessons to enjoy that interest together. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) school club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda belongs to an organised group of students with a shared interest. They meet regularly after lessons to enjoy that interest together.” Bu tarif “school club” kelimesine uyar; school club = okul kulübü. Diğer şıklar: science project (bilim projesi), announcement (duyuru), group photo (grup fotoğrafı).

4

Can puts both legs inside a large bag. He hops towards the finish line against other children in bags. He joins a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) sack race

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can puts both legs inside a large bag. He hops towards the finish line against other children in bags.” Bu tarif “sack race” kelimesine uyar; sack race = çuval yarışı. Diğer şıklar: tug-of-war (halat çekme), graduation (mezuniyet), experiment (deney).

5

Emir practises outdoor games at school. He uses a large area marked out for sports. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) playing field

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir practises outdoor games at school. He uses a large area marked out for sports.” Bu tarif “playing field” kelimesine uyar; playing field = oyun, spor sahası. Diğer şıklar: ceramic workshop (seramik atölyesi), workshop (atölye), science project (bilim projesi).

6

Baran's school organises a joyful event in its own hall. Teachers and students gather there to mark a special occasion. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) celebration at school

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran's school organises a joyful event in its own hall. Teachers and students gather there to mark a special occasion.” Bu tarif “celebration at school” kelimesine uyar; celebration at school = okulda kutlama. Diğer şıklar: group photo (grup fotoğrafı), announcement (duyuru), school club (okul kulübü).

7

Tolga fills in a form to ask for a place on a school trip. He does not yet know whether the school accepts his request. He is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) applicant

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga fills in a form to ask for a place on a school trip. He does not yet know whether the school accepts his request.” Bu tarif “applicant” kelimesine uyar; applicant = başvuru sahibi, aday. Diğer şıklar: competition (yarışma), result (sonuç), prize-giving ceremony (ödül töreni).

8

Ozan succeeds in a competition. The organisers give him a gift because of his result. He receives a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) prize

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan succeeds in a competition. The organisers give him a gift because of his result.” Bu tarif “prize” kelimesine uyar; prize = ödül. Diğer şıklar: approval (onay), participant (katılımcı), effort (çaba).

9

Yusuf reaches an important goal after months of work. Completing it successfully means a lot to him. It is a major ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) achievement

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf reaches an important goal after months of work. Completing it successfully means a lot to him.” Bu tarif “achievement” kelimesine uyar; achievement = başarı. Diğer şıklar: winner (kazanan), award (ödül), applicant (başvuru sahibi, aday).

10

Aras rides a strong bicycle on rough paths in the hills. He enjoys cycling away from smooth roads. His activity is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) mountain biking

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras rides a strong bicycle on rough paths in the hills. He enjoys cycling away from smooth roads.” Bu tarif “mountain biking” kelimesine uyar; mountain biking = dağ bisikleti. Diğer şıklar: school trip (okul gezisi), route (rota, güzergâh), view (manzara).

11

Gökçe walks through a large area covered with trees. Wild plants and animals live among the many trees. She is in a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) forest

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe walks through a large area covered with trees. Wild plants and animals live among the many trees.” Bu tarif “forest” kelimesine uyar; forest = orman. Diğer şıklar: hillwalking (tepelerde doğa yürüyüşü), rowing (kürek çekme), fresh air (temiz hava).

12

Kerem looks at a very high natural rise in the land. Its steep sides lead towards a high summit. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) mountain

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem looks at a very high natural rise in the land. Its steep sides lead towards a high summit.” Bu tarif “mountain” kelimesine uyar; mountain = dağ. Diğer şıklar: adventurous activity (macera dolu etkinlik), lake (göl), nature club (doğa kulübü).

13

Deniz visits an unfamiliar historic place. A person leads the visitors and explains what they see. This person is their ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) guide

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz visits an unfamiliar historic place. A person leads the visitors and explains what they see.” Bu tarif “guide” kelimesine uyar; guide = rehber. Diğer şıklar: route (rota, güzergâh), view (manzara), mountain biking (dağ bisikleti).

14

Onur books a journey online. He receives his travel ticket digitally and shows it on his phone. It is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) e-ticket

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur books a journey online. He receives his travel ticket digitally and shows it on his phone.” Bu tarif “e-ticket” kelimesine uyar; e-ticket = e-bilet. Diğer şıklar: city tour (şehir turu), room service (oda servisi), historic site (tarihî yer).

15

Arda checks a detailed travel plan. It lists the places to visit and the times for each part of the journey. It is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) itinerary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda checks a detailed travel plan. It lists the places to visit and the times for each part of the journey.” Bu tarif “itinerary” kelimesine uyar; itinerary = gezi programı. Diğer şıklar: travel agency (seyahat acentesi), destination (varış yeri), resort (tatil köyü).

16

Ali needs somewhere to stay during a trip. He compares hotels and other places that provide a room for the night. He looks for ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) accommodation

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali needs somewhere to stay during a trip. He compares hotels and other places that provide a room for the night.” Bu tarif “accommodation” kelimesine uyar; accommodation = konaklama. Diğer şıklar: visa (vize), hotel (otel), historic site (tarihî yer).

17

Efe spends his holiday travelling on a large passenger ship. The ship visits several places during the journey. He goes on a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) cruise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe spends his holiday travelling on a large passenger ship. The ship visits several places during the journey.” Bu tarif “cruise” kelimesine uyar; cruise = gemi gezisi. Diğer şıklar: city tour (şehir turu), destination (varış yeri), itinerary (gezi programı).

18

Berk practises making beautiful decorative letters. He carefully controls a pen or brush to create artistic writing. He studies ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) calligraphy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk practises making beautiful decorative letters. He carefully controls a pen or brush to create artistic writing.” Bu tarif “calligraphy” kelimesine uyar; calligraphy = hat, güzel yazı sanatı. Diğer şıklar: cultural heritage (kültürel miras), national anthem (millî marş), solidarity (dayanışma).

19

Burak watches a formal tradition for preparing and serving tea. Each step follows a special order. He watches a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) tea ceremony

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak watches a formal tradition for preparing and serving tea. Each step follows a special order.” Bu tarif “tea ceremony” kelimesine uyar; tea ceremony = çay seremonisi. Diğer şıklar: independence (bağımsızlık), children's rights (çocuk hakları), compassion (merhamet).

20

Tuna's family welcomes visitors warmly. They offer food, help and a comfortable place to sit. They show ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) hospitality

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna's family welcomes visitors warmly. They offer food, help and a comfortable place to sit.” Bu tarif “hospitality” kelimesine uyar; hospitality = misafirperverlik. Diğer şıklar: national anthem (millî marş), calligraphy (hat, güzel yazı sanatı), cultural heritage (kültürel miras).

21

Aylin's community stands together during a difficult time. People unite and support one another rather than acting only for themselves. They show ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) solidarity

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin's community stands together during a difficult time. People unite and support one another rather than acting only for themselves.” Bu tarif “solidarity” kelimesine uyar; solidarity = dayanışma. Diğer şıklar: children's rights (çocuk hakları), tea ceremony (çay seremonisi), independence (bağımsızlık).

22

Nehir sees someone suffering and feels deep concern. She wants to ease that person's pain and offer care. She shows ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) compassion

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir sees someone suffering and feels deep concern. She wants to ease that person's pain and offer care.” Bu tarif “compassion” kelimesine uyar; compassion = merhamet. Diğer şıklar: hospitality (misafirperverlik), national anthem (millî marş), cultural heritage (kültürel miras).

23

İpek has important news for the whole school. She plans to tell everyone publicly so they know about it. She wants to ______ the news.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) announce

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek has important news for the whole school. She plans to tell everyone publicly so they know about it.” Bu tarif “announce” kelimesine uyar; announce = duyurmak. Diğer şıklar: hold an event (etkinlik düzenlemek), discuss (tartışmak, görüşmek), organise (düzenlemek).

24

Eylül studies two travel plans. She looks at their similarities and differences before choosing one. She wants to ______ them.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) compare

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül studies two travel plans. She looks at their similarities and differences before choosing one.” Bu tarif “compare” kelimesine uyar; compare = karşılaştırmak. Diğer şıklar: prepare (hazırlamak), require (gerektirmek), collaborate (iş birliği yapmak).

25

Cemre stands in front of a large audience. She prepares to speak formally about the value of education. She is there to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) give a speech

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre stands in front of a large audience. She prepares to speak formally about the value of education.” Bu tarif “give a speech” kelimesine uyar; give a speech = konuşma yapmak. Diğer şıklar: take part in (katılmak), welcome (karşılamak), practise (pratik yapmak).

Vocabulary Test 2 · Sonuç
0/ 100 puan
✔ Doğru: 0✘ Yanlış: 0○ Boş: 0

Her soru 4 puan. Yanlış ya da boş bir soruya tıkla; o soruya gidip doğrusunu ve Türkçe çözümünü gör.

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

announcement

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) duyuru

“announcement” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “duyuru” olur. Bu ifade “Okul etkinlikleri” grubundandır. Örnek: The headmaster made an announcement.

2

workshop

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) atölye

“workshop” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “atölye” olur. Bu ifade “Okul etkinlikleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We joined a painting workshop.

3
